steps.title: Performance Goals
steps.text: Surgewave targets 1M+ messages per second, sub-millisecond P50 latency, under 10ms P99, and zero heap allocations on the produce and fetch hot paths.

steps.title: The Hot Paths
steps.text: The produce and fetch hot paths are the critical performance paths. Every allocation on these paths creates GC pressure that causes P99 latency spikes.

steps.title: Zero-Allocation Patterns
steps.text: Use Span<T> for stack-only views, stackalloc for small temporary buffers, ArrayPool for large buffers, ObjectPool for complex objects, and ValueTask for sync-fast paths.

steps.title: SIMD and Hardware Acceleration
steps.text: Surgewave uses SSE4.2 intrinsics for CRC32C checksums at one cycle per byte and Vector<T> SIMD for cosine similarity at 8 floats per instruction on AVX2.

steps.title: Performance Regression Suite
steps.text: The regression detector compares BenchmarkDotNet results against baselines with configurable thresholds. It generates Markdown reports and fails CI on detected regressions.
